goal: 3D isometric cutaway of the whole floor for an interior-design presentation board.
facts: One open-plan kitchen, dining and living space of 85.93 m2, about 5.98 m wide and 15 m deep, with a separate 1.92 m2 guest toilet and a straight staircase going up on the left side.

Kitchen at the far end: L-shaped run of tall and base cabinets along the end wall and right wall, a five-sided bay window projecting from the end wall, and a 260 x 110 cm island with an induction cooktop, an undermount sink and four bar stools on the living-room side.
A single round structural column stands in the open space between the kitchen and dining zone.
Entrance door on the right wall between the kitchen and dining zone.
Dining zone: one long rectangular table about 240 x 100 cm with eight chairs, and two lounge armchairs against the left wall.
A freestanding low media wall about 20 cm deep separates dining from living.
Living zone: a long sofa under a full-width window on the bottom wall, a second sofa on the right wall, two armchairs on the left wall, and two nested square coffee tables in the centre.
Several tall narrow windows on both long side walls.
locks: Follow the supplied floor plan for room shape, zone order, wall, window, door and stair positions, and furniture placement.
Keep one island, one round column, one dining table with eight chairs, and the bay window.
No text, dimensions, labels, logos or watermarks in the image.
freedoms: Exact finishes, lighting fixtures, rugs, plants, art and small styling props may be chosen to fit the style.

direction.thesis: Warm modern calm: one continuous light-oak and warm-white volume that reads as a single, generous room.
direction.signature: Sage-green upholstery throughout, echoing the plan, against a honed travertine island and matte-black details.
direction.avoid: Generic cold grey showroom render with glossy white surfaces and empty, staged rooms.

composition: High three-quarter isometric 3D view from above with walls cut at about 1.2 m height, showing the whole floor from kitchen to living room.
Every zone and every furniture piece from the plan is visible; clean neutral background outside the walls.
rendering: Photorealistic architectural visualization at professional interior-design presentation quality.

Materials: wide-plank light oak floor, warm white plaster walls, light oak and warm-white flat-panel kitchen cabinetry, honed travertine island, matte black tapware and slim pendant lights, sage-green boucle and linen upholstery, natural wool rug, linen curtains.
Soft natural daylight from the windows, warm accent lighting, realistic shadows and reflections, correct scale and vertical lines.

authority.intended_use: Concept interior-design renders for the owner's own design work.

review_tests: All zones appear in the plan's order: kitchen with bay window, island, column, dining, media wall, living.
Furniture counts and positions match the plan; no text appears.
